name: cocos2d
description: Use when the user asks about Cocos Creator 3.x, Cocos2d-x, a Cocos game, node and component scripting in TypeScript, Cocos builds for web or mobile, or Cocos performance. Produces Cocos project structure, gameplay code and build settings. Not for Cocos2d-x engine internals (use cocos2d-patterns) or other engines (use unity or godot).
